<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><IMG SRC="tm2619099d1_ex99-1img001.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>S&amp;P GLOBAL INC. COMPLETES SEPARATION OF
MOBILITY GLOBAL INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>NEW YORK, JULY 1, 2026 &ndash; </B>S&amp;P
Global Inc. (NYSE: SPGI) announced today that it has completed the separation of its Mobility division into an independent, public company,
Mobility Global Inc. (&ldquo;Mobility Global&rdquo;). Mobility Global common stock will begin regular-way trading today on the New York
Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol &ldquo;MBGL&rdquo;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&ldquo;<I>The successful completion of this separation
reflects the extraordinary work and dedication of the S&amp;P Global and Mobility Global teams over the past 15 months</I>,&rdquo; said
Martina Cheung, President and CEO of S&amp;P Global. &ldquo;<I>Together, we have built a strong foundation for Mobility Global as an independent
company and both companies stand well-positioned for the future</I>.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The separation was achieved through the distribution of 100 percent
of the shares of Mobility Global to holders of S&amp;P Global common stock effective as of 12:01 a.m. New York City time on July 1, 2026,
with S&amp;P Global stockholders receiving one share of Mobility Global common stock for every share of S&amp;P Global common stock held
at the close of business on June 15, 2026, the record date. S&amp;P Global stockholders entitled to receive the distribution received
a book-entry account statement or a credit to their brokerage account reflecting their ownership of Mobility Global common stock. Fractional
shares of Mobility Global common stock were not distributed. Any fractional share of Mobility Global common stock otherwise issuable to
a S&amp;P Global stockholder will be sold in the open market on such stockholder&rsquo;s behalf, and such stockholder will receive a cash
payment for the fractional share based on its pro rata portion of the net cash proceeds from all sales of fractional shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">S&amp;P Global expects to issue a press release on July 6, 2026 providing
recast financial information for full year 2025, the four quarters of 2025 and the first quarter of 2026, reflecting the completion of
the spin-off of Mobility Global.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Morgan Stanley &amp; Co. LLC, Goldman Sachs &amp; Co. LLC, Citigroup
Global Markets Inc. and Evercore Group L.L.C. served as financial advisors and Davis Polk &amp; Wardwell LLP and Baker McKenzie LLP served
as legal advisors to S&amp;P Global.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>About S&amp;P Global</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">S&amp;P Global (NYSE: SPGI) enables businesses, governments, and individuals
with trusted data, expertise and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading
benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive in a rapidly changing global
landscape.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">From helping our customers assess new investments across the capital
and commodities markets to navigating the energy expansion, acceleration of artificial intelligence, and evolution of public and private
markets, we enable the world&rsquo;s leading organizations to unlock opportunities, solve challenges, and plan for tomorrow &ndash; today.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B></B></P>

statements,&rdquo; as defined in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These statements, which express management&rsquo;s
current views concerning future events, trends, contingencies or results, appear at various places in this press release and use words
like &ldquo;anticipate,&rdquo; &ldquo;assume,&rdquo; &ldquo;believe,&rdquo; &ldquo;continue,&rdquo; &ldquo;estimate,&rdquo; &ldquo;expect,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;forecast,&rdquo; &ldquo;future,&rdquo; &ldquo;intend,&rdquo; &ldquo;plan,&rdquo; &ldquo;potential,&rdquo; &ldquo;predict,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;project,&rdquo; &ldquo;strategy,&rdquo; &ldquo;target&rdquo; and similar terms, and future or conditional tense verbs like &ldquo;could,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;may,&rdquo; &ldquo;might,&rdquo; &ldquo;should,&rdquo; &ldquo;will&rdquo; and &ldquo;would.&rdquo; For example, management may
use forward-looking statements when addressing topics such as: the outcome of contingencies; future actions by regulators; changes in
the business strategies and methods of generating revenue of S&amp;P Global Inc. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;); the development and performance
of the Company&rsquo;s services and products; the expected impact of acquisitions and dispositions; and the Company&rsquo;s effective
tax rates; the Company&rsquo;s cost structure, dividend policy, cash flows or liquidity.</P>
